messages:
Ravi Shah: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A thread. I captured a few clarifications leadership asked for and who will own each. Short thread so we don't spam the channel.

Maya Patel: Thanks Ravi 44aa Can you also paste the slide link with the traffic projection numbers? Execs want a one-line takeaway.

Ravi Shah: Slide deck here: https://redwood-internal.company/slides/2026-03-allhands.pdf. One-line takeaway I heard: "Projected steady growth +10-15% w/ Dedicated signups; plan for 20% burst headroom." Ben, want to confirm the burst assumption?

Ben Torres: Confirmed 44d We modelled 20% burst for the next quarter based on current trials. Will add a sentence in the ticket about cost impact.

Evelyn Cho: One leadership ask: clarity on Dedicated vs Private timeline for compliance customers. Can we give target weeks?

Maya Patel: Short answer: Dedicated GA by mid-April, Private VPC beta in early May, Private on-prem pilot by late May. I'll add exact week numbers into the roadmap note.

Ravi Shah: Owners I have so far:
- Roadmap timeline writeup: Maya
- Cost delta estimate for execs: Ben
- Compliance sales one-pager: Evelyn
- Follow-up customer comms draft: Ravi
React with :white_check_mark: when you own it.

Ben Torres: I'll take cost delta. Marking :white_check_mark:.

Evelyn Cho: Taking compliance one-pager. Will ping Legal for any verbatim language. :white_check_mark: 

Maya Patel: Taking timeline writeup. Adding a short risk blurb about Private on-prem dependency on partner packaging. :white_check_mark: 

Ravi Shah: For implementation details on the Dedicated capacity SLOs: we promised a single-tenant baseline with 99.9% uptime and p95 < 180ms under committed load. @ops-bot can you attach the SLA snippet to the ticket?

ops-bot: Attached SLA snippet to ticket AH-3190. Also scheduled a reminder for owners on Monday 09:00 PT.

Ben Torres: One dev ask from the Q&A: leadership requested a short example of cost/perf tradeoff using quantization + batching. Evelyn, can you coordinate with Eng-ML for a short chart?

Evelyn Cho: Will do. I'll pull a 2-line summary + chart by Wednesday COB. Eng-ML, pinging you in #eng-ml.

Maya Patel: Also adding the post-ah action checklist to the Confluence page: https://redwood-internal.company/confluence/ah-followups-2026-03. Please add notes directly there if you're blocked.

Ravi Shah: Action summary (copied into AH-3190):
- Maya: roadmap week-level timeline + risk blurb (ETA Tue EOD)
- Ben: cost delta and exec-friendly note + chart (ETA Wed noon)
- Evelyn: compliance one-pager + coordinate legal + quantization chart (ETA Wed COB)
- Ravi: draft customer comms and schedule send (ETA Thu)

Maya Patel: Small ask from Sales that came up: include a one-paragraph FAQ that covers SLAs, onboarding time, and data residency. Who can draft?

Ben Torres: I can draft the SLA/onboarding paragraph. Evelyn can add the residency/legal bits.

Evelyn Cho: Sounds good. I'll add residency language.

Ravi Shah: Final note: if anyone needs more than their stated ETA, reply here and we'll reassign. Closing thread now and will update ticket AH-3190 and Confluence. Thanks all!

ZoomBot: Meeting recording (all-hands): https://zoom.company/rec/abc123 (available to staff)
